class.name: NNAngleToVector3SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scores and filters based on the node minimum and maximum angle compared to the set [member angle_to_direction_vector].
class.description: The [Vector3] angle search criterion scores and filters [Node3D] candidates based on the unsigned angle (in [code]0..180[/code] degrees) between [member angle_to_direction_vector] and the node's forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]). When used for scoring, the angle is mapped linearly from [code]0.0[/code] at or below [member min_angle_degrees] to [code]1.0[/code] at or above [member max_angle_degrees] (by default [code]0..90[/code] degrees), then passed through [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] if one is set.

members.member: Reference direction compared against each candidate's forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]) as an unsigned angle in [code]0..180[/code] degrees.

Maximum unsigned angle in degrees (at most [code]180.0[/code]; larger values are ignored). Angles above this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]1.0[/code] when scoring. If less than or equal to [member min_angle_degrees] on ready, adjusted to [code]min_angle_degrees + 1.0[/code].

Minimum unsigned angle in degrees. Angles below this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]0.0[/code] when scoring.
